responsibility: Supplies shared rs6000 target macros for e500/SPE configurations. It defines predicates for SPE ABI, SPE instruction availability, use of GPRs versus FPRs for floating-point, and e500 single/double modes, and centralizes option validation that rejects incompatible combinations such as Altivec or VSX with SPE, 64-bit SPE, or FPR-based hard float on e500 targets.
